cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Tell the committee we're considering the festival bid. Just the announcement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Once they've reserved the date, we'll have something worth protecting.

beats.text: I prefer starting with the consequence that encourages us.
